job.title: Partner Campaign Strategist @ Tomorrowland (Antwerpen, VLG, BE)
job.description:
Description

We are looking for a **Partner Campaign Strategist** who can translate partner objectives into impactful 360° marketing campaigns across the Tomorrowland ecosystem.

We are seeking someone with strong strategic thinking skills, a deep understanding of channels, content, community, and culture, and the ability to shape campaigns from briefing through evaluation.

At Tomorrowland, we believe that strong partnerships go beyond visibility alone. That is why we are building a dedicated agency team to deliver these services in the long term. As a Partner Campaign Strategist, you will ensure that partner campaigns are not only creatively inspiring but also strategically sound, measurable, and relevant to both our global community and those of our partners.

**Your Role**
-------------

As a Partner Campaign Strategist, you are responsible for translating partner objectives and partnership strategies into integrated marketing campaigns that are culturally relevant, scalable, and measurable. You work at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and creativity, ensuring that campaigns are both strategically strong and highly effective.

You leverage market insights, cultural trends, and community needs to develop partner campaigns that go beyond visibility, creating meaningful value for both the partner and the broader Tomorrowland ecosystem.

You develop thecommunication strategy, marketing plan, and content plan for partner campaigns and determine how and through which channels a partner story can best come to life; from social platforms and experiences to earned and paid media, UGC, creators, and out-of-home (OOH) advertising.

You work with a clear strategic framework: Partner Objective × Tomorrowland DNA × Community × Amplification. This ensures that campaigns are not only creatively compelling but also aligned with broader brand strategy, community relevance, and commercial objectives.

You are a strong team player who connects multidisciplinary teams and ensures creative concepts are developed based on clear marketing goals, target audiences, and KPIs.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Translate partner objectives, market insights, cultural trends, and KPIs into **360° campaign strategies and marketing plans**.
* Develop **campaign frameworks, content plans, and distribution strategies**.
* Define the **go-to-market approach**, including channels, formats, storytelling, creators, audience touchpoints, and amplification opportunities.
* **Strategically brief content and concept teams**, ensuring creative development is rooted in clear marketing objectives and partner value.
* Analyze campaign performance and translate insights into **optimizations and future strategies**.
* Contribute to making global partnership platforms locally relevant and actionable without compromising the consistency of the Tomorrowland DNA.
* Monitor trends and developments in global entertainment, culture, creator marketing, social platforms, experiential marketing, and brand campaigns.

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in marketing strategy within creative agencies or brand partnership environments.
* Strong strategic mindset and a solid understanding of marketing channels, distribution, and audience behavior.
* Strong affinity for culture, communities, creator marketing, and international brand campaigns.
* Proven experience in developing integrated 360° marketing campaigns.
* Experience leading or coordinating multidisciplinary creative teams.
* A true team player who collaborates effortlessly with partnerships, marketing, creative teams, and external partners, while aligning multiple stakeholders around a clear direction.
* Excellent writing and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly both visually and conceptually.
* A strong understanding of the unique Tomorrowland DNA and the ability to translate it into inspiring and unexpected campaigns.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

You will join a dynamic team where strategy, creativity, and culture come together. You will work on international campaigns with global partners and play an active role in shaping how brands come to life within the Tomorrowland universe.

Our company is constantly evolving, with innovation, growth, and creativity at its core. The projects you work on are often groundbreaking, challenging, and highly visible to audiences around the world.

Languages Dutch; Flemish English

job.title: Social Media & Community Coordinator @ River Cleanup (Antwerp, Flemish Region, Belgium)
job.description:
**About River Cleanup**
River Cleanup is a global nonprofit working toward a clear goal: plastic-free rivers. We bring communities together to clean rivers today and keep them clean for the future. Through cleanups, prevention, data and community-led solutions, we take action on plastic pollution while building long-term solutions that stop waste before it reaches our rivers. Our global community has already mobilized 400000 people across more than 100 countries, and we're continuing to grow.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Social Media & Community Coordinator to bring River Cleanup's stories, campaigns and impact to life across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube. This is a hands-on role covering the full day-to-day social media cycle: planning, creating, publishing, engaging, promoting and reporting. You'll write copy, create visual content, shoot and edit short-form video, manage our online community and execute paid social campaigns. You'll work within the social media and campaign strategies set by the Director of Digital Marketing & Communications while bringing your own creativity, ideas and understanding of what works on social. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, plans ahead and keeps things moving.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Create & manage content
  
  

* Manage River Cleanup's day-to-day presence across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube.
* Support the growth of River Cleanup's social media channels by creating engaging content, actively engaging our audiences and identifying opportunities to extend our reach.
* Maintain a content calendar planned at least one month ahead and aligned with our campaigns and communications priorities.
* Coordinate social content with wider communications activity, including campaigns, website content, email and other marketing channels.
* Write engaging social copy adapted to different platforms and audiences.
* Create on-brand visual content using Canva.
* Shoot and edit engaging short-form video for Reels, TikTok and other social formats.
* Brief and coordinate external agencies, freelancers and content creators to support content production and campaign delivery, helping build a trusted network of external creative partners around the core Communications team.
* Schedule and publish content, ensuring it is accurate, timely and consistent with the River Cleanup brand.
* Identify relevant stories, trends and content opportunities.
* Work with colleagues and River Cleanup teams around the world to source stories, images, video and information.
* Capture and publish content from key River Cleanup campaigns, cleanups and events when needed.

Engage our community
  
  

* Manage comments, direct messages and community emails, providing timely and appropriate responses.
* Actively engage with followers and relevant online communities.
* Build relationships with creators and influencers who can help extend River Cleanup's reach.
* Surface recurring questions, feedback and relevant conversations from our community to the wider team.

Manage paid social
  
  

* Set up and manage paid campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok based on established campaign strategies, audiences, budgets and objectives.
* Monitor and optimize campaigns throughout their lifecycle.
* Track spend and performance and flag issues when campaigns are not on target.
* Report on paid campaign results.

Measure performance
  
  

* Monitor organic and paid social performance across channels.
* Produce regular reporting against agreed KPIs.
* Identify meaningful trends, opportunities and areas requiring attention.
* Use performance data to make day-to-day content execution stronger.

**Requirements**
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
  
  

* +3 years of professional experience in social media, digital communications, content creation or a related role.
* Experience managing social channels for an organization, brand or agency.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Professional proficiency in either Dutch or French; proficiency in both is strongly preferred.
* Strong social media copywriting skills.
* Experience independently shooting and editing short-form social video.
* Demonstrable Canva skills and a good eye for engaging visual content.
* Hands-on experience setting up, managing, optimizing and reporting on paid social campaigns.
* A strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube and how content works differently across them.
* Experience with Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager, as well as TikTok Ads Manager.
* Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, GA4 and social scheduling or reporting platforms is an advantage.

**How You Work**

* You're highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
* You plan ahead rather than relying on last-minute execution.
* You take initiative, spot opportunities and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions.
* You take ownership of your work and follow through.
* You're comfortable receiving constructive feedback and applying it to your work.
* You have strong attention to detail and flag potential issues early.
* You're curious about social media and keep up with changing formats, trends and platform behavior.
* You enjoy working with people from different teams, countries and backgrounds.

**What Success Looks Like**
Our social channels are active, engaging and consistently on-brand. Content is planned ahead and campaigns go live accurately and on time. Our community receives timely responses, and performance is regularly tracked and reported. You know what's coming next and are prepared for it. You flag problems early, act on strong content opportunities and use feedback to continuously improve your work.
  
  
**Benefits**
WHAT WE OFFER
  
  

* The opportunity to have an impact at the forefront of making rivers plastic-free.
* Being part of a growing, dynamic and fun team.
* A non-profit competitive benefits package incl. 20+6 paid vacation days
* DKV hospitalisation insurance
* The opportunity to use River Cleanup electric vehicles for work-related travel
* Compensation for bicycle commuting and meal vouchers
* Free lunch on Tuesdays!

DETAILS
  
  

* We offer up to two remote working days per week. Tuesday and Thursday are mandatory in-office days, while the remaining working days can be agreed upon with your manager in line with team and business needs.
* To help you settle in and connect with the team, we ask new starters to be on-site as much as possible during the first 6 months before transitioning to the standard arrangement.
* This position is a full-time position (39 hrs / five days).
* Starting date: asap

**How To Apply**
At River Cleanup, we believe in the power of diversity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We encourage everyone to apply, regardless of age, gender, origin, or physical abilities.
  
  
Upload your CV and motivation letter together with examples of social media work you've created via the link below. We're particularly interested in seeing examples of your copywriting, visual content and short-form video.

job.title: Partner Marketing @ Gigs (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
**About Gigs**
--------------

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We're tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you're driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we'd love to hear from you.

**Things We Care About**
------------------------

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

* **Speed.** We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
* **Ownership.** If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
* **Customer Obsession**. Our customers' product is our product.
* **Ambiguity.** We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
* **First principles.** We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

**The Role**
------------

Gigs signed several major partners this summer, and each one needs someone on the ground to turn the contract into customers. That someone is you.

You'll report to our Head of Marketing and own partner marketing for one market. Your partners include banks, fintechs, retailers and the carriers that supply local lines. In France we're building a launch around a carrier and the first banks and platforms to go live.

Partners run their own apps, calendars and budgets. You get them to spend on Gigs by showing up with a clearer view of what works than they have, and by getting commitments written into the contract before launch. The best time to shape a partner's marketing plan is before launch, so you'll be involved early in the deal.

Nobody has done this job at Gigs in your market yet. We want a new kind of partner marketer for it: local, close to consumers, and happy to build things with their own hands. You'll do it from scratch, and quickly.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* **Own partner go-to-market.** Once a partner integrates, the launch plan, joint calendar, local positioning, budget and results are yours. You also review the creative. You decide what gets made and why.
* **Get marketing into the deal early.** Our best leverage comes before signing. You research prospective partners and give a view on whether they'll work. Channels, user reach, lifecycle emails and promo budgets get written into the contract at that stage.
* **Use the partner's own surfaces.** In-app placement, push notifications, deep links and rewards programs move attach rate. You find the ones that matter for each partner and persuade them to use those.
* **Run MDF like an investor.** We co-fund a promo only when it brings in new activity, and the partner pays for paid media alongside it. Money is released as milestones are hit. You work with our analytics lead on pre/post and A/B tests so we never pay for sales that would have happened anyway.
* **Adapt the story to your market.** A message that lands in New York can fall flat in Paris, London or São Paulo. You decide what carries over and what gets rebuilt. AI can draft, and a native speaker reviews anything going to a wide audience.
* **Be the local voice.** You work with PR agencies, local press and podcasts to get the Gigs and partner story out. Carrier launches need legal, comms and compliance sign-offs that can take weeks, so you plan early.
* **Build the playbook for smaller partners.** Our biggest partners get a proactive strategy from you. Everyone else gets help on request or a self-serve library covering promotions, social, paid and affiliate, and you help write it.
* **Work with the rest of Gigs.** Sales, Partner Success, Product and Design all touch the partner story, as do partner marketers in the US and UK. You keep the story consistent, send local learnings back to the global playbook, and use the intake process so requests arrive scoped.
* **Report on results.** Each week you update our growth levers tracker with campaign status and incremental ARR. You carry your share of the marketing incremental ARR target.
* **Use AI daily.** It speeds up your drafting and research. You'll also help shape how Gigs and our partners show up in LLMs and other AI-driven channels.
* **Prepare for APAC.** As we move into Asia, you turn what works in your market into toolkits that regional leads can pick up.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* **Selling through partners.** You know how to move people you don't manage, such as a bank's marketing head or a carrier's comms team. You're strong before the deal, when positioning and the marketing case get set, and after it, when activation happens. This is the heart of the role.
* **A consumer marketer's instincts.** Audience research, lifecycle, CRM, push and in-app messaging are second nature. You know LTV, attach rate, ROAS and incrementality cold. Telco experience is a bonus, and we teach the model. People with a B2B2C background are rare, so consumer subscription, payments and marketplace candidates do well here.
* **Roots in your market.** Native French or Portuguese, strong English. You know the local press, the carriers and the banks. You can tell when a message needs translating and when it needs rewriting.
* **Zero-to-one experience.** No playbook, no team and no templates existed, and you built the thing anyway. You write the brief and ship the asset yourself. A team may come later.
* **Commercial sense.** You understand co-funding, milestone-based spend and the limits of attribution. A revenue play, where co-funding makes sense, looks different to you from a loyalty play, where the partner should pay. We judge this role on your judgment and partner instinct more than on dashboards.
* **Daily AI use.** It makes you faster and more creative, and you know which output needs a human reviewer.
* **Startup or agency background.** Fintech, payments, marketplaces and consumer subscriptions all translate well. High-growth experience helps.

Bonus points for experience with carriers, eSIM or travel products, merchant-led programs like Apple Pay, or partner programs at a scale-up. Time spent watching a global brand adapt across Latin America, Europe or Asia helps too.

**Work At Gigs**
----------------

**It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!**

No one is more creative and data-driven than this team, they have the best of both worlds!
  
  
The Marketing team's main mission is to get our product into the hearts of millions of users around the world.
  
  
The Growth team builds innovative ideas to conquer markets, attract, and retain users.

Led by Isa, our CMO, they are constantly innovating to take our business to new heights.
  
  
🎯 What you will do
  
  
At Joko, our goal is to turn social media into a primary engine for brand awareness and user acquisition. As our Social Media Manager, you won’t just manage an inbox; you will own the strategic distribution of Joko’s voice across the digital landscape.
  
  
You will bridge the gap between creative production and algorithmic performance. Using a data-first approach and cutting-edge AI tools, you will ensure that every piece of content we produce achieves maximum reach and resonates with our target audience.
  
  
You report to Luisa our Head of Brand & Communications will work closely with the whole Marketing team to translate insights, trends, and performance signals into a high-performing social media strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and execute Joko’s social media growth and distribution strategy: You’ll design and run a multi-channel strategy across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook to maximize reach, engagement, and positive brand sentiment.
* Master platform algorithms and distribution mechanics: You’ll continuously test formats, hooks, posting cadence, and platform-native features to improve organic reach and ensure every piece of content performs at its highest potential.
* Implement AI-powered community operations: You’ll deploy and manage automation tools to handle routine community interactions such as DMs, FAQs, and tagging while maintaining Joko’s tone of voice.
* Act as the human-in-the-loop for high-impact interactions: You’ll step in during sensitive conversations, viral moments, and interactions with brand advocates to ensure thoughtful and on-brand responses.
* Anticipate trends and cultural shifts: You’ll actively monitor social platforms and emerging conversations to identify opportunities for Joko to participate early and stand out.
* Translate trends into actionable creative direction: You’ll turn social insights and cultural signals into clear briefs for the Content Creator to ensure our output remains relevant, distinctive, and thumb-stopping.
* Own social media performance and insights: You’ll manage our social media dashboards, track advanced performance indicators such as share of voice, virality, and assisted conversions, and provide actionable insights to guide our content strategy.
* Expand Joko’s social media ecosystem: You’ll develop initiatives that amplify our reach beyond owned channels, including creator collaborations, ambassador programs, and proactive brand participation in key social conversations.

👀 Who we're looking for
  
  

* Experience: At least 5y experience in Social Media Strategy, Growth Marketing, or Brand Management, preferably in a fast-paced B2C startup or top-tier agency.
* Strategic Mindset: You don't just "post content", you understand how a TikTok video fits into a 12-month brand vision.
* AI Savvy: You are excited about using AI to automate the boring parts of the job so you can focus on the big picture.
* Data Literacy: You are comfortable with data visualization tools and can turn a spreadsheet of metrics into a compelling narrative for the CMO.
* Editorial Excellence: Native in French and perfect English proficiency. You have a "social-first" writing style (witty, concise, and perfectly aligned with Joko's DNA).
* Project Leadership: Ability to lead a content calendar and coordinate between the Creative, Growth, and Brand teams without losing sight of deadlines.
* Growth Instinct: You are obsessed with virality mechanics and have a proven track record of growing accounts or launching successful social campaigns.

**💎 Our perks**
*(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)*
At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:
  
  

* Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
* Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

**On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks**

* 💸 Top-market compensation
* 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
* 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
* 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
* 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
* 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
* …and much more, check the full list here!

**🤝 Our hiring process**

* Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
* Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
* Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

+ For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
+ For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

* Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
* References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

Domain Expert III (Strategy & Business Development) (312138)

Als onderdeel van de Marketing for Growth-transformatie binnen de bank draag je vanuit één geïntegreerde waardeketen bij aan duurzame en winstgevende groei door marktinzichten, klantinzichten, segmentstrategie , marketingstrategie en marketing executie met elkaar te verbinden. Vanuit Segment Development Team Corporate Banking geef je richting aan de Marketing & Digital waardeketen, creeer je alignment tussen stakeholders en fungeer je als strategische sparringspartner voor segment management, Marketing & Digital, Brand & Corporate Communications en Product Units.

Marketingstrategie

* Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de marketingstrategie van Corporate Banking als integraal onderdeel van de segmentstrategie.

Sturing van de Marketing for Growth-waardeketen

Je bent onderdeel van het Segment Development Team Corporate Banking Clients en vervult een sleutelrol binnen het Marketing for Growth-operating model. Je opereert op het snijvlak van strategie, commercie en marketing en werkt nauw samen met:

* Corporate Banking Clients, inclusief de landen
* Marketing & Digital

* Data & Analytics
* andere Segment Development Teams

We zoeken een ervaren marketeer die strategie weet te combineren met executiekracht, stakeholders kan verbinden en commerciële kansen weet te vertalen naar impactvolle marketinginitiatieven. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

* Ervaring met strategische marketingplanning en segmentontwikkeling
* Een duidelijke visie op marketing, klantbehoeften en marktontwikkelingen
* Creatief, ondernemend en commercieel sterk

job.title: In-House Performance Marketeer | Fast Growing Scale-up | Rotterdam @ Monday Merch (Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
The Performance Marketeer
  
  
We’re looking for a hands-on, experienced Performance Marketeer to join our growth team in Rotterdam. Monday Merch is one of the fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands. We give companies worldwide one place for all their merch: design, production, long-term storage, online stores and events, in 15+ countries.
  
  
This is an in-house role. You directly own most of our Google and Microsoft Ads accounts and countries, you work with a freelance specialist who runs a few countries, and you work day to day with a founder and the growth team.
  
  
The team
  
  
You join the growth team at our Rotterdam office: one founder who leads growth and is your day-to-day counterpart, a UI/UX designer who designs and builds our site, landing pages and shop, and our design and content people.
  
  
Remote, you work with a freelance Google Ads specialist who runs about 30% of the countries and search budget, a Meta Ads specialist, and our SEO, web and analytics support.
  
  
Our office in the centre of Rotterdam holds 40+ young, international, bright and hard-working people. Our Megacenter on the edge of the city adds about 60 more, and a remote team of around 100 people works with us worldwide.
  
  
Your Goal
  
  
Grow the number of new customers we win through paid search, at a cost that keeps every market profitable, and help us hit our yearly targets. You run the main markets and 70%+ of the budget yourself, and you work with the rest of the team to improve everything around the ads: tracking, landing pages, offers.
  
  
Your Metrics
  
  

* New-customer ROAS (per market)
* New opportunities per month (per market)

Responsibilities
  
  

* Be the in-house owner of paid acquisition. You run the main markets yourself and keep the whole picture together: a bi-weekly sync with our freelance Google Ads specialist (smaller markets) and our Meta Ads specialist, one shared plan across all markets, and the cross-market work (tracking, feeds, structure) done once for everyone. As you gain more experience, you grow into leading paid acquisition as a whole.
* Run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads for your markets (about 70% of budget): execute the weekly change list (keywords, negatives, targets, budgets), challenge it when the data says otherwise, and keep the accounts clean.
* Keep every market on pace against its monthly and yearly plan, and act when it drifts.
* Own tracking and attribution. Our B2B sales process can be long and complicated. Our CRM sends opportunity and deal values to the ad platforms; you make sure that stays accurate across Google, Microsoft and GA4. Our tech team builds and adjusts, you specify and test. You have all the data and tools at your disposal: Claude, GA4, PostHog, CRM and platform data, and you dig in yourself.
* Write and test ad copy and assets across languages, with native speakers where needed.
* Pick landing pages that match the search, brief and run landing-page tests with our UI/UX designer and content people, and keep Merchant Center and the Shopping feeds healthy across markets.
* Run new experiments: new campaign types, new markets, new offers.
* Think along on the bigger picture with the growth lead: which market offering we improve next, which product categories we advertise on and how we make them profitable. You pull in the people it takes: UI/UX, product, content, sales.
* Work with our AI tooling (Claude) every day.
* Pick up growth work beyond ads when it comes up: outbound campaigns, new channels, content, landing pages. Search stays your core, but nobody here stays only in their own lane.

You
  
  

* Work hard, are results-driven, and like being measured on real outcomes.
* Have 2–4 years hands-on in SEA or performance marketing, on accounts of €50k+ per month.
* Work in a structured way.
* Are AI-pilled: you get excited about trying new ideas and finding better ways to work with AI.
* Communicate clearly in English. Dutch and other languages are a plus.

Why Monday Merch?
  
  

* Rapid growth opportunities in a fast-paced scale-up, and one founder as your direct counterpart.
* One account, €2M+ a year, real ownership of execution and growth across 10+ markets, including US.
* Work from our beautiful office in the city centre of Rotterdam.
* Work with great tools (including a brand new MacBook) and bright, hard-working people.
* Yearly workation (2026 was Gran Canaria).
* Salary: €3,400–4,100 gross per month on a full-time basis, depending on experience.
* Paid days off: 23 days per year.
* Full-time, on-site at our Rotterdam city-centre office, no systematic WFH
* FD Gazelle 2026 and Deloitte Technology Fast 50 2026: experience working at one of the fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands.

How we hire
  
  

* A 20-minute call.
* Interview at our office: you walk us through an account you ran, and we go through one of our markets in detail.
* Offer, usually within a week

job.title: Recruitment Performance Marketeer @ Driessen (Helmond, NB, NL)

You'll own these things end to end. You can set the plan and run it.

**Must-haves**
--------------

We care more about ambition than your past titles.

* **1–3 years in marketing**, ideally in brand, content or communications at a B2B software or tech company.

* **You have a visual eye.** You can tell on-brand from off-brand, and you can make simple edits yourself in Figma or Canva.

**Nice to hav****e**

None of these are required.

* Portuguese or Spanish at a professional level
* Short-form video: scripting, filming or editing
* Background in product analytics, mobile apps or developer tools
* Hands-on time in a CRM like HubSpot

***This role is NOT a fit if you are***
---------------------------------------

* Wanting a role where you don't need to take ownership
* Hesitant to embrace new AI tools and tech-forward workflows
* Uncomfortable with taking risks when it comes to content

#### **What we'll offer you**

job.title: Growth Lead, New Brand, Germany @ Eucalyptus (Berlin, Germany)
job.description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.
  
  
We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.
  
  
You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.
  
  
We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.
  
  
We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.
  
  
We hope that's you.
  
  
**What's next?**
We're launching a globally recognised brand in Germany, taking it from zero to one. You'd build the growth function from scratch, own the trajectory, and decide where the money goes.
  
  
The right person has spent most of their career in DTC or subscription businesses, lives in Meta and paid social, and runs everything through the numbers. If you're the kind of person who opens the ads manager before your emails in the morning, this is probably for you.
  
  
Germany is our fastest-moving market. It runs its own budget and makes its own calls. From day one you'd have real spend, real targets, and the autonomy to go after them.
  
  
**About The Role**
You report to the Head of Growth for Germany, who owns budget allocation across the German portfolio. You'd own everything underneath that for this brand: channel strategy, creative testing, forecasting, and performance reporting to senior leadership every week or two.
  
  
A creative strategist joins you from day one and reports to you. You set the testing agenda and decide what goes to market. Once the brand can carry it, you'd hire a growth manager underneath you.
  
  
Most of your week goes on doing the work, not directing it.
  
  
**You'll**

* Own channel strategy from zero - paid social and search first, then you decide where the next euro goes
* Own forecasting: spend, CAC, patient volume, and the conversation when the numbers shift
* Decide the creative testing agenda - you set the bar and decide what runs
* Lead the weekly performance read-outs to senior leadership
* Hire your team, once the brand earns it

Six to ten years in performance marketing, most of it DTC or subscription. You've built campaigns from scratch, shipped launches, and fixed what broke.
  
  
Meta and paid social are where you spend most of your time. You're numerical by instinct - you reach for the data before you reach for an opinion, you can build a forecast, back it with logic, and say plainly when it's wrong.
  
  
You've worked somewhere high-growth with thin resourcing, preferably a start-up / scale-up environment where the remit was wide and the support wasn't. You enjoy getting your hands dirty: jumping into ad platforms, iterating on landing pages, running experiments, and not waiting for someone else to do it.
  
  
You understand performance creative - not just what the numbers say but why an ad works. You have a view on what makes people stop scrolling, what drives someone to click, and what turns a curious visitor into a paying customer. You can brief a creative strategist with enough precision that the output is right first time, and you know when something isn't working before the data catches up.
  
  
**Why join Eucalyptus?**

* What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem. ii. Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding. iii. Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support. v. job.title: Growth Lead, Germany @ Voy (Berlin, Berlin, Germany)

Voy is a healthcare platform led by clinicians. We support people managing long-term health conditions with treatment plans backed by real evidence.
  
  
Founded in 2018, we started as MANUAL, focusing on hair loss, weight loss and men’s health. As we grew, we realised we could help more people. We're looking for a Growth Lead to own how Voy acquires new patients. You'll run a multi-million-euro budget across every acquisition channel and the team who deploy it.
  
  
Voy supports over 2 million members across the UK, Germany, Brazil, India, and Poland. You'll have full ownership from day one, a direct line to the executive team, and a mandate to keep us scaling beyond 10 figures ARR.

job.title: Junior Marketing Manager (m/w/d) @ cs concept GmbH (Regensburg, BY, DE)
job.description:
**Content & KI** - Regensburg · Vollzeit · 39 Stunden pro Woche

**Eigene Ideen einbringen. Mit KI arbeiten. In einem erfahrenen Team wachsen.**

Du möchtest ins Marketing einsteigen, kreativ arbeiten und erleben, was deine Ideen bewirken? Bei CS Concept gestaltest du mit uns, wie wir Software und künstliche Intelligenz für unsere Kunden verständlich und interessant machen. Dabei kannst du deine Rolle von Anfang an mitgestalten, eigene Projekte anstoßen und deine Ideen verwirklichen.

**Das sind wir**

CS Concept ist seit über 20 Jahren am Markt und gehört zu den großen deutschen ALLPLAN-Vertriebspartnern. Wir betreuen Kunden rund um ALLPLAN und weitere Software aus dem Portfolio der Nemetschek Group.

Bei uns arbeitest du in einem kleinen, persönlichen Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Austausch mit der Geschäftsleitung. Wir unterstützen einander – im Arbeitsalltag und wenn es persönlich einmal schwierig wird. Verlässlichkeit und ein gutes Miteinander gehören für uns zusammen.

Durch unsere enge Zusammenarbeit mit ALLPLAN und Nemetschek erhältst du Einblicke in das Umfeld einer großen Softwaregruppe. Gleichzeitig kannst du bei uns früh Verantwortung übernehmen und deine Ideen direkt einbringen.

**Das gestaltest du bei uns**

* Du entwickelst mit unserer Vertriebs- und Marketingleitung Themen und Kampagnen.
* Du bringst eigene Projektideen ein und setzt sie in Abstimmung mit unserer Vertriebs- und Marketingleitung eigenständig um - von der ersten Idee bis zum Ergebnis.
* Du erstellst Inhalte für unsere Website, Kundenmailings und Social Media.
* Du erklärst Softwarefunktionen und KI-Anwendungen anhand konkreter Kundenaufgaben.
* Du unterstützt bei Videos, Webinaren und Produktvorstellungen.
* Du nutzt KI für deine Marketingarbeit, probierst neue Möglichkeiten aus und prüfst die Ergebnisse.
* Du wertest mit uns aus, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und zu Kundenanfragen führen.
* Als Teil unseres kleinen Teams unterstützt du bei Bedarf auch im Tagesgeschäft, etwa am Telefon, bei der Abwicklung von Schulungsaufträgen oder bei organisatorischen Aufgaben.

**Das bringst du mit**

* Erste Marketingkenntnisse aus Studium, Ausbildung, Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eigenen Projekten.
* Neugier auf Software, KI und die Arbeit unserer Kunden.
* Eigeninitiative, kreative Ideen und Lust, diese umzusetzen.
* Die Bereitschaft, dazuzulernen und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

ALLPLAN musst du noch nicht kennen. Wir helfen dir, unsere Produkte und Kunden zu verstehen. Auch als Quereinsteiger mit passenden praktischen Erfahrungen bist du willkommen.

**Darauf kannst du dich freuen**

* Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Rolle: Gemeinsam entwickeln wir dein Aufgabengebiet nach deinen Fähigkeiten, Interessen und Entwicklungswünschen weiter. Wir sind überzeugt, dass du dort den größten Beitrag leisten kannst, wo du deine Stärken einbringst und gerne arbeitest.
* Persönliche Einarbeitung durch unsere Vertriebs- und Marketingleitung.
* Unterstützung durch einen erfahrenen Kollegen für Website, Mailings und KI.
* Ein etabliertes Unternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive.
* Ein Team, in dem du gehört wirst und auf Unterstützung zählen kannst.
* Eine Vollzeitstelle mit 39 Stunden pro Woche in Regensburg.

Für deine Einarbeitung arbeiten wir vor Ort im Büro eng zusammen. So lernst du unser Team, unsere Produkte und unsere Kunden kennen und hast direkte Ansprechpartner für deine Fragen.

**Zeig uns was dich begeistert**

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und erzähl uns kurz, warum dich die Aufgabe interessiert. Wenn du schon Texte, Videos, Kampagnen oder eigene Projekte umgesetzt hast, freuen wir uns über Beispiele. Interessant ist für uns auch, welchen Anteil du selbst übernommen hast und wie du dabei KI eingesetzt hast.

**Starttermin**

Ab sofort oder zu einem späteren, gemeinsam abgestimmten Zeitpunkt. Ein Start ist sowohl noch in diesem Jahr als auch Anfang 2027 möglich.

Art der Stelle: Vollzeit, Festanstellung

Arbeitsort: Vor Ort
